chunks.content: Shipplix Standard Delivery operates Monday through Friday between 8:00 AM and 6:00 PM. Typical transit time is 1-3 business days within metropolitan zones. Tracking updates are sent automatically via WhatsApp and SMS at each hub scan.

Weekend & Express Coverage: Saturday and Sunday deliveries are available on Shipplix Express Plus tiers across all primary boroughs in New York City (including Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens) and Greater London. Deliveries occur from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM with direct recipient signature or secure porch drop.

Damaged or Missing Items & Return Policy: Customers can initiate an automated return within 14 days of delivery. Photos of damage can be sent directly to this WhatsApp number for instant automated inspection and replacement dispatch within 24 hours.

Commercial E-Commerce Volume Tiers: For businesses shipping over 500 parcels weekly, Enterprise Tier applies at £2.85 (or $3.60 USD) per standard domestic parcel under 2kg. Includes free daily scheduled warehouse pickups, direct API integration, and guaranteed next-day delivery.
Enterprise Account Manager: For companies sending more than 500 parcels per week, a dedicated Logistics Success Manager is assigned. Invoicing terms are NET-30 with weekly consolidated billing.
